answer: Persistent attention escrow. Each identity must keep a funded watch balance that is consumed in real time only while its agent is actively processing a random challenge stream; idle or unanswered challenges drain it. A gale of parallel sybil identities therefore multiplies the concurrent attention each must sustain. The vault releases funds only against continuous verified responsiveness, so an attacker pays full parallel attention cost per identity. Losing even an ember of responsiveness forfeits the remaining balance.
